personalInformation.title: Personal information
personalInformation.photoHint: JPG, PNG, GIF or WebP. You crop it before the photo is saved.
personalInformation.cropHint: Drag the photo and zoom until you sit inside the circle. Any shape is fine; only the circle is kept.

signature.title: Email
signature.description: Your signature, and whether sending an email closes the conversation.
signature.empty: Bokito default: your photo beside your name, role and contact details. Without a photo, a circle with your initials.
signature.editorContext: Your personal signature. Used when the mailbox source is “each person's signature”, or when the mailbox template is empty. Leave empty for the Bokito default with your photo.

language.title: Language
language.description: Choose the language for your interface.
language.deviceHint: This language stays on your account.
language.saveError: Language changed for this session, but could not be saved to your account.

emailClose.label: Close email when I send
emailClose.hint: Send closes the email conversation. The menu next to Send still offers Send and keep open. Chat and WhatsApp stay open.
emailClose.saveError: Could not save this email setting.

landing.title: Start page
landing.description: Choose where Bokito opens after you sign in. New chat is the default.
landing.saveError: Could not save your start page.

theme.title: Appearance
theme.description: Select a theme to personalize your dashboard's appearance.

security.title: Security
security.description: Manage your password, connected accounts, and two-factor authentication.
security.passwordDescriptionSet: Set a password so you can sign in without Google or Microsoft, and unlink those accounts safely.
security.passwordModalDescription: Enter your current password and choose a new one.
security.passwordModalDescriptionSet: Choose a password so you can sign in without Google or Microsoft.
security.passwordModalDescriptionMfa: Enter your current password, choose a new one, and confirm with the code from your authenticator app.
security.passwordTotpHint: Open your authenticator app and enter the current 6-digit code.
security.connectedDescription: Link Google or Microsoft to sign in faster. Unlink only when you still have a password or another provider.
security.connectHint: Not linked yet. Connect to use this provider at sign-in.
security.notConfiguredHint: This provider is not configured on this server.
security.unlinkBlocked: Set a password or connect another provider before disconnecting your only sign-in method.
security.totpOnDescription: A code from your authenticator app is required at sign-in.
security.totpOffDescription: Protect your account with an extra step at sign-in.
security.totpOnHint: Configured with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Microsoft Authenticator, and similar).
security.totpOffHint: Not set up yet. Enable to require a 6-digit code after your password or SSO.
security.totpStep1: Scan the QR code with your authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Microsoft Authenticator, ...), or enter the key manually. Then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
security.totpDisableConfirm: Enter your password to turn off two-factor authentication. You can set it up again later.

session.title: Session
session.description: Manage your sign-in on this device.

account.title: Account
account.description: Sign out or permanently delete your account.
account.signOutDescription: Log out of your current session on this device.
account.deleteDescription: Permanently delete your account and all associated data. This action cannot be undone.
account.deleteConfirm: Delete your account permanently? This cannot be undone.
account.deletePasswordPrompt: Enter your password to confirm deletion:

errors.uploadAvatarUnsupported: That file type is not supported. Use JPG, PNG, GIF, or WebP.
errors.resendVerification: Could not resend the verification email.
errors.totpDisable: Could not turn off two-factor authentication.
